note: Sprint 83 Phase B — DECLARATIVE contract only. The three projections below are IMPLEMENTED later (the authoring surface phases). Phase B fixes the invariant: all three projections edit the SAME workflow through the SAME command model, so switching projection never changes meaning — identical semantic digest. Editing must be possible without drag, by voice, by keyboard, and by screen reader (accessible authoring, ATAG 2.0).

commandModel.note: One command vocabulary shared by every projection. The SEMANTIC digest is computed over the ordered log of `commands` ONLY (never a projection's pixels or layout). NO semantic command carries a layout argument (a canvas position): placement lives EXCLUSIVELY in `viewCommands` (a DISJOINT set canonically EXCLUDED from the digest), so two projections whose logs differ only by placement hash IDENTICALLY — by construction. The digest filter is therefore explicit: digest(log) = hash(log filtered to entries whose id is in `commands`). Example: [node.add(kind=llm)] and [node.add(kind=llm), node.place(nodeId=n1, at=[40,80])] produce the SAME digest — the placement is a view command, dropped before hashing.
